_comment: Stage 5 section 3.1: explicit, reviewable, versioned source-class -> target-class map for the DETECTION-format dataset. Distinct from results/external_class_mapping.json (Phase 12, crop-classifier, single-label-per-crop) though it carries forward and re-verifies the same decisions. Structured per target class (ps_class) with one row per contributing SOURCE class/MID, because the detection converter needs the full mid->ps_class table to do an exhaustive per-image requery (stage5 section 2.1) - not just the classes a given import run happens to be fetching.

re_verified_against.method: every boxes/images figure below and every zero-match/absent claim was re-read from the current audit JSON and, for absences, grepped directly from the raw classes.csv on 2026-09-17 - not carried forward from the Phase 12 document without re-checking.

open-images-v7.note: 5000-image download, NOT exhaustively annotated (stage5 section 2.1) - an image queried for one class may contain an unboxed instance of another mapped class.

data/objects.note: the developer's own Studio captures. An entry's own_capture.object_id names the Studio object profile that supplies the identical class when/if own data exists for it.

entries.reason: Direct, unambiguous correspondence. Ample sample size; already proven end to end for the crop classifier (Phase 12).

own_capture.note: developer's own Studio watch samples were soft-deleted during Phase 12 with no restore path (docs/decisions.md); external-only for this stage.

entries.reason: Both are generic hand-held drinking vessels, matching the single COCO 'cup' primary-tier concept objects/vocab.py already collapses to. Combined 763 boxes across up to 566 unique images (before the ~540 estimate's own-image overlap and this stage's dedup are applied). Carried forward from Phase 12's crop-classifier mapping, re-verified against the current audit.

Direct correspondence, by far the most abundant candidate class - NOT selected as this stage's second class (see docs/phase-reports/phase13-stage5-dataset.md section 4): median box_area_frac is only 0.0199 (vs mug/cup's 0.107-0.150), i.e. most Bottle boxes are small/distant, a data-quality concern for a first multi-class proof.
Direct correspondence, abundant data, but not imported this stage (section 4 scope: watch + one justified second class only).
